translation: Na ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ⟨as⟩ ɔman no teɛ, sɛ ⟨as⟩ ɔsɔfoɔ no teɛ; sɛ ⟨as⟩ akɔfoɔ no teɛ, sɛ ⟨as⟩ ne wura teɛ; sɛ ⟨as⟩ odwɛfoɔ no teɛ, sɛ ⟨as⟩ ne awuraa teɛ; sɛ ⟨as⟩ wɔn a wɔtɔn no teɛ, sɛ ⟨as⟩ wɔn a wɔtɔn no teɛ; sɛ ⟨as⟩ wɔn a wɔde sika bɔ no teɛ, sɛ ⟨as⟩ wɔn a wɔfa sika bɔ no teɛ; sɛ ⟨as⟩ wɔn a wɔbo mfasoɔ so no teɛ, sɛ ⟨as⟩ wɔn a wɔde bɔ no teɛ.
